<thought>I'll retrieve polymorphs for a few oxide compositions using the batch_retrieve_polymorphs tool, applying the required filters (max_energy_above_hull = 0.3, max_per_composition = 3). I'll save the files to a relative directory “oxides_data” within the current workspace.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
<action_input>{
    "compositions": ["TiO2", "SiO2", "Al2O3", "Fe2O3", "CuO"],
    "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
    "max_per_composition": 3,
    "save_directory": "oxides_data"
}</action_input>
